fit_reason: Private owner selling a whole 2014 Jeep Patriot SUV.
findings: Paint looks somewhat flat and dull on the hood and doors rather than deep and glossy
Water spotting and light film visible on the hood and front fascia
Unpainted black plastic fender flares and lower bumper look a bit faded and grey
Stick-figure family decal on the rear glass that buyers may prefer removed
No interior photos, so interior condition cannot be judged
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 2014 Patriot. From the photos the paint on the hood and doors looks a little flat, and the black fender flares and bumper trim have faded toward grey. We do mobile pre-sale details, including a buff and trim restoration, and can come to you. Would you like a quote?
